topic: Linear Systems & Fundamental Subspaces: A Visual Journey

sections.title: Geometric Interpretation: The Intersection of Worlds
lecture_lines: Linear systems represent the intersection of lines.
Two equations define two distinct paths.
Their intersection point is the unique solution.
animations: Line 1: Fade in two crossing lines on a #FFFFFF grid.
Line 2: Color the first line #FF0000 and the second #00FF00.
Line 3: Indicate the single point of intersection with a #FFFF00 circle.

sections.title: The Inverse Matrix: The 'Undo' Button
lecture_lines: Inverse matrices act as undo buttons.
Matrix A transforms a vector's position.
Inverse A brings the vector home.
animations: Line 1: Display an identity matrix #FFFFFF and a transformed matrix #AAAAAA.
Line 2: Show the inverse matrix as a #00FFFF vector reversing the transformation.
Line 3: Animate a point moving from origin to target, then returning.

sections.title: Column Space: The Reach of a Transformation
lecture_lines: Column space is the reach of transformation.
It spans all possible reachable destinations.
Visualize this as a reachable region.
animations: Line 1: Display column vectors #FF00FF and #FFFF00 in 3D space.
Line 2: Span the flat #666666 surface covered by these vectors.
Line 3: Label the output vectors as they lie within this span.

sections.title: Null Space: The 'Ghost' Zone
lecture_lines: Null space collapses vectors to zero.
It acts as a ghost zone.
Everything here becomes invisible to transformation.
animations: Line 1: Highlight vectors being mapped to the origin #FF0000.
Line 2: Show a translucent plane #0000FF forming the null space.
Line 3: Shrink a vector in the plane until it vanishes.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary
lecture_lines: Invertible matrices span the whole space.
Singular matrices collapse dimensions into lines.
Algebra connects deeply with geometric intuition.
animations: Line 1: Write Ax = b in large #FFFFFF text.
Line 2: Pulsing highlights on determinant, inverse, and space labels.
Line 3: Draw connecting lines between the three concepts in #FFFF00.
